note: THE FRINGE FAMILIES (principal 2026-10-10). Ten information families the desk's ontology did not name, each placed explicitly in the universe: a family id, named public/licensed candidate sources with a TERMS status, an MT5 economic mapping (instruments + channel) and a conversion stage that research/breadth_frontier.py DERIVES every hour from the tree (never typed here). TERMS ARE FAIL CLOSED: a source reads PERMITS only with a verbatim clause from its OWN terms page that clearly permits automated access, read with WebFetch and quoted below with the date it was read; every other source is HELD, is never fetched, and is reported as HELD. A HELD source with a `partial_quote` had its terms page read and the page did not clearly permit automated access -- the quote is kept so nobody re-reads it as a permit.
terms_rule: PERMITS requires a verbatim quote from the source's own terms page clearly permitting automated access for internal research; otherwise HELD and never fetched.

families.name: Hyperspectral, radar (SAR), RF, acoustic and seismic sensing

mt5_mapping.channel: a seismic event or SAR-visible disruption at a mine, port, refinery or LNG train is a supply shock: metals and energy reprice first, then the exporter's currency (AUD, CAD, JPY after domestic quakes) and the exposed index; hyperspectral crop vigour leads the softs.

families.name: Credit plumbing: repo, funding and settlement fails

mt5_mapping.channel: repo rate spikes, funding-volume shifts and settlement fails are balance-sheet stress: front-end Treasuries and the dollar bid first (funding squeeze), risk indices and gold respond to the liquidity drain or its relief.

families.name: Capital-formation exhaust: IPO / bond issuance pipelines, prospectus filings

mt5_mapping.channel: an IPO and follow-on calendar that swells is supply and a late-cycle risk-appetite gauge for the indices; a heavy investment-grade issuance week weighs on duration (UST10Y) and pulls dollars in.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR S-1/F-1/424B filings via data.sec.gov and full-text search
quote: To ensure everyone has equitable access to SEC EDGAR content, please use efficient scripting.
Please declare your user agent in request headers:
sources.conditions: declared user agent, at most 10 requests per second; the same page forbids botnets and crawling the site outside this policy

families.name: Enterprise dependency exhaust: package registries, SaaS status pages, supplier graphs

mt5_mapping.channel: dependency adoption and outage cascades are an operating read of the software economy: the tech-weighted indices respond, and a supplier-graph shock into Asian manufacturing reaches the funding and exporter currencies.

families.name: Public-infrastructure telemetry: grid, ports, traffic, water

mt5_mapping.channel: grid load and generation mix move gas burn and therefore XNGUSD; port and traffic throughput are a real-time trade-volume read for the exporters' currencies; a water-level shock on an inland waterway reprices the barge-borne softs and energy.

mt5_mapping.channel: observed temperature, precipitation and storm warnings drive heating/cooling gas demand and crop stress: XNGUSD and the softs reprice ahead of the official crop and storage reports.

families.name: Knowledge-production signals: papers, patents, preprints, standards

mt5_mapping.channel: a surge in preprints and patents on a material or technology is a demand prior: silver (photovoltaics), copper and platinum (electrification, hydrogen) and the tech-heavy indices carry it before any order book shows it.

mt5_mapping.channel: a spike in attention to a currency, gold or a crisis term precedes retail flow; the retail-heavy instruments (gold, the crypto CFDs, the yen crosses) absorb it with a lag institutions ignore.

sources.name: MediaWiki Action API (prop=pageviews)
quote: There is no hard and fast limit on read requests, but we ask that you be considerate and try not to take a site down.

Use a descriptive User-Agent header that includes your application's name
sources.conditions: serial requests, maxlag, descriptive user agent. This record covers the Action API only: the REST pageviews endpoint alt_proxies uses is a different door whose terms this record does not read
